Be careful of Summit necromancers and mesmers, as they carry enchantment removal. The foes are low level so almost any farming build will work. A run yields approximately 12-18 badges. ==Collectors== {{:Asgrim Brightaxe/Collector armor}} {{:Ornhelm Brightaxe/Collector}} {{:Horseman Calstein/Collector}} {{:Abbot Silverbeard/Collector}} {{:Nicholas the Traveler/Collector|6th June 2011 and 17th March 2014|Tasca's Demise|3 [[Stone Summit Badge]]s}} == Notes == * [[Ornhelm Brightaxe]] trades 5 Stone Summit Badges for items that sell for 125 {{gold}} to a merchant. This provides a return that is over three times the value of the trophies themselves. * This item is frequently confused with [[Stone Summit Emblem]]s, since both trophies [[drop]] from [[Stone Summit]] dwarves and share the same icon. However, the badges only drop in Prophecies while the emblems drop only in [[Eye of the North]].
